It was a class where I was the only boy, and all my classmates were hidden behind veils, to my eye, that was not something I was used to seeing. It was very uncomfortable, it bothered me cause the fact persisted, that they must be bothered by me too. All in all, the class was one and I was me alone. I could not distinguish any further at this stage. But stages change, and in these changing stages, I began to notice certain individuals due to different reasons. Some approached me first, some laughed a lot, some had their Fsc marks speaking for them, and a certain someone that soon caught my eye for things that distinguished her from the others.

First, she almost was a seat mate, our seats pretty close to each other. We almost sat right next to each other. Unlike others I observed, she did not give a damn about me or any other boy. That was when I was said to myself, “be careful, you don’t want to mess with her.” At one time, I thought to myself, she always stays silent, and unsocial, does she lacks confidence, probably yes was how I replied to myself, though I was soon to be proven wrong. I was not a fan of mysterious girls, but I was not myself anymore as well who said that earlier statement. She caught my eye and I wanted to know about her. But how, I cannot even talk to her without a logical reason. Wait a second, an application, I could have given it to Nimra and to Radia, but at that time, neither of them were in class and as usual she stayed behind. This was my chance. And I gave that to her, god I was scared but it went better and sweeter than I had imagined. After the weekend when I came back, I was surprised to hear that since the application lacked HOD’s signature and stuff, she took it upon herself to mark it all…. Wow I thought to myself, she really does do her job, isn’t that the meaning of my name. And soon later, I noticed, it was not confidence she lacked but a certain poise she possessed. And that was when I started to view her from the anime glasses my mind always wear. She stays silent, has the skills but remains quiet, she doesn’t randomly socialize, doesn’t randomly talk, and gives this super mysterious aura, she must have had a tragic past or something. I did not even know the name of this girl yet, though luckily I had the class attendance sheet, and while the teacher was taking attendance, I stuck up my ear to see which number she spoke on…. 18, so she was called Maham. Hmmm nice, and 18, ahhh, such a nice number.

For some reason, speaking her name made me blush, or rather guilty would be the more accurate word, she was unaware that I would be talking about her, of course to myself but I still decided to drop the name, and go up with a nickname, and what better than 18. That was the day, the girl, who sat beside me came to be known as 18 to me. I would mention in my diary if anything to her as 18 and so on. Now, giving her a nickname, searching for her name, trying and looking for a chance to talk, all these things were stuffed inside my head. I looked at myself, and asked my inner conscious, hey shitty, do I like her? the conscious replied, yes….. I was like woah, easy…. Whaaaat, how, why…. And the conscious said, hold on boy, it said, you like her, you do, but I never said what type of like. You like her and respect her as a person just like you would to any other girl as well, your feelings though, thinking about her are only due to her being a bit unique. Weren’t you always attracted towards the unique things, it’s the same with people, you want to know her better, that’s it. I looked at myself again, the voice of conscious had gone now, I had received the answers I wanted. My heart was safe. Though, I did start to observe her. I labelled this silent girl as a term, I once read in a manga, Taka no hana, which means the untouched flower. Referring to those people who live in a world of their own and no one should interact with them. With this, I was fine not knowing about her, and finally living on my cool headed life. The heat rush of my mind was now over. But life is not so forgiving is it.

Two things happened, one, I noticed she started talking with others more often now, it was natural, but as taka no hana I was a bit disappointed. I was being an idiot I know, secondly, I noticed a change in her approach to me. Its not like she approached me or anything, just the cold aura emanating from her saying, approach at your own risk had lessened. I saw her laugh due to me, two time, I was so happy that she can laugh too, but her laugh also had the feel of a tragic heroine. As if she had not laughed for so long and would just cry if she did a bit more. This would make me worry for some reason…. I know the tragic heroine stuff was all in my head things but they were there. Also, I sometimes felt, I was being observed by her as well, but then I would laugh at myself in my mind and said, “haha rajeel, come out of your self conscious fantasies.”

But one day It was an attack to the mind of this peaceful ghareeb once again when one day, she came out of the class and waved to sitting ghareeb in the lawn to come for the English class. That moment was time stopping. I was like wait, what, is this really happening, she came out to call me ? she noticed my absence, so I did existed for her, oh god, and to think a girl who doesn’t interact with others would come out of her way to call me, I felt honored…. And that day, my heads was filled with flowers which nimra stole 2 days later when she in a discussion randomly mentioned, it was her who send 18 to call me, in short, it was GR who noticed the missing rajeel, not 18 herself. I felt betrayed but once again back to reality, and this time for sure, I was not going to let my own stupid fantasies mess with me. Time went by, I moved one chair away from her in thoughts that she might not like it me sitting on the chair besides her when the one besides me was empty, I felt as if she would think I am a cheap boy. All in all, she was a different person and I was just happy knowing that a unique girl exists in class, and hoped that she just respected me in her heart, that would have been enough for me. And was ready to live my remaining life in the uni in that same fashion. But life once again had some other plans.

I was talking to GR on WhatsApp (texting) when I suddenly saw, Maham 18…. Typing …… my face literally turned like that of the screaming emoji….. I could not believe my eyes. Why would she message me? Though Gr told me she asked her to ask me about the reference links, and I was like oh, but still happy, at least she did ask me something, that was the first messages in our chat, and honestly I had not really imagined it would get any further. I tried my best to keep my answers concise so that she won’t get bothered. And once that started, she soon after 2 days as far as I remember asked about something from intro again, and I was happy to be of help. This, I have no memory of how, but turned into a chat one day. And during that chat I was blowned away. She was such a philosophical person. I was stunned. And happy as well to know she was more amazing than I thought she was. Though I was really scared because she did not know me, and I was afraid to let her assume something wrong about me, I had the habit to blabber baqwas but luckily I sustained. It appeared that she was inquiring about my past the next day, and as much as I tried to keep it hidden because I was insecure of the consequences, I ended up telling her, and 18 really took it in positive way. Though the next day she made me promise to her that I wont share my past with anyone else. Now that I think about it, this promise really benefitted me. I would be able to stay mysterious as well. But why would she go through all that trouble, for someone like me? She was also really different on text then I assumed her to be. But all in all, she was an amazing caring funny person who looked after others, and shared a lot of similarities with me. And soon we became good friends, and despite not being the frankest, well not frank at all, I think she is the one I am closest to, as a friend. Though I am a bit afraid, though it might be too late now, that, what if, I become use to talking to her, it would be difficult later on then for me. But then will be looked at then.

It took me some time to get use to her way of talking on text, cause the use of acha and hmm and ok g and those cold chills that I get sometimes, were really scary for me. But now, I have gotten accustomed to what’s what and what. It has become a hobby for both of us to, me eat muqqas a day, and she feed muqqas a day. 18’s a nice and kind person who I still haven’t fully understood but then again, can women ever be fully understood.

One thing still bothers me to this day is that, when live, she seems really nervous, and its as if she doesn’t like me around. Due to the confidence I got from her, I tried to approach her 2 times, and well both times I felt as if she got annoyed, that literally makes me soul scream from the inside. I do hope I haven’t made her upset and that she gets accustomed soon.

18, is an amazing person who I wanted to write about in a more better way but for version 1 of this abstract, this is it so far. TO be continued in version 2.

18 [ Part 2 ]

More than a year has passed, since part 1 finished. Tomorrow, is going to be 3rd December. A so called anniversary day. The day, I lost the battle of love is war. The day I confessed. Now, for a reader, this might be very weird. How, from awkwardly talking we went to a confession ( though nothing surprising ) and how from there, an year passed, where, we even crossed some taboo lines, that should not have been crossed.

Reading 18 Part 1 honestly made me laugh, and even pity myself a lot. Because, as much as I wanted to stay logical and away from topics of love, I got dragged in again, all due to my weakness. I really suck. Secondly, my opinion of 18, ahhh, I still admit 18 being an amazing girl, but amazing in other ways, not the ones I thought to be.

All things aside, woah, with a very happy heart, I would like to state, 18, is on the way to becoming an otaku. She is an anime fan, and, yeah. Originally she watched it only for me, cause, you know, girls and their tactics, but she admitted being genuinely interested in them and has even crossed 50 completed. Heck she completed Fairy Tail. With her days being almost 20. Though my family still says that she is only doing it for now and won’t do it after marriage, I think otherwise.

Marriage, yeah, we have gone to that stage. So many fights already happened, all my family knows and stuff. To think me who was looking forward to staying single and not involve with the women gender was now fighting for marriage in his first and third semester of university. Splendid.

We talk normal, everyone in the class knows, we walk normal, we sit together, and no one bothers, we have held hands, kissed each other’s hands. And even couplexting, if you know what that means now. And though a lot weird stuff happened between us, we still are together.

Alot of beautiful moments happened between us. And, my view of her is totally changed now, but we are pretty compatible and I would still want her to be my partner.
